FormSection.name: Email
FormSection.note: Section appears because "Email" is included in Campaign Channels Select. Set # of Emails and Save — one CRF #N tab opens per email, each with its own fields and Save button.

FormSection.name: MDS - Target List and Supressions
FormSection.note: MDS does have planning content — it just isn't on this base card. Target list & suppression rules are per-tactic: open the CRF #N tab for the tactic you need, its MDS Suppression fields live there. Fields differ by Audience model (toggle there).

FormSection.name: Data Cloud details
FormSection.note: Exists only for campaigns activated through Data Cloud (HQE Adhoc & E360). XM supplies these values after the Brand Discovery session.

FormSection.name: Automatrix
FormSection.note: Content-metadata fields for MLR-approved assets, tracked per tactic — open the CRF #N tab for the tactic you need, its Automatrix fields live there. Populated once the matching Email tactic provides a FUSE ID.

FormSection.name: SMS
FormSection.note: Section appears because "SMS" is included in Campaign Channels Select. Set # of SMS and Save — one CRF #N tab opens per SMS, each with its own fields and Save button.

FormSection.name: CMA Metadata Sheet
FormSection.note: A standalone section, not a buried OMS field — this is entirely the AOR's responsibility to fill, and it's required before the CPF can be considered complete. It only comes into scope once Asset Scope is New Brand/New Indication, Enrollment Sign-Up is Yes, and Metadata Source is New metadata (set in OMS - Enrollment Form Details).
